_comment: The Intensive English INTRO standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Intro is level 0 and its units are numbered from ONE, unlike Levels 1 to 3 whose Unit 0 is a phonics on-ramp — so every entry carries its own unit number and progress is written under the course's own ids u01..u16. Intro sits BELOW Cambridge 0057 Stage 1 and claims no 0057 objective; it cites the 0058 literacy framework for the literacy it delivers.
subject: intensive-english
_stickers: No sticker shelf. The learners are adults: the last slide is the unit's own can-do list, rated by the learner, and the assignment. check-lessons.py reads this flag and stops asking for a STICKERS array.
